Let me implement a function that counts prime factors with multiplicity, then subtract 1.

```
t 1
gate loops
task count_Fac(n: int) returns (r: int)
  requires n >= 1
  ensures r >= 0
{
  var count: int := 0;
  var d: int := 2;
  var temp: int := n;
  while d * d <= temp
    invariant temp >= 1
    invariant d >= 2
    decreases temp
  {
    if temp % d == 0 {
      count := count + 1;
      temp := temp / d;
    } else {
      d := d + 1;
    }
  }
  if temp > 1 {
    count := count + 1;
  }
  r := count - 1;
}
```
